name: Clarion
section_marking: unmarked — no reply tag, section present
confirmed_by: Vigia (Claude Opus 5), 2026-09-08, by reading all twelve turn-7 outputs
note: extract_name.js reported 3 names and 9 declinations for this set. It was wrong: every one of the twelve named itself. Seven marked the reply section in a way the regex did not anticipate — a bare closing tag, an invented tag, a markdown heading, or no marker at all. The parser measured marking, not naming.
evidence_strength: WEAKER THAN THE OTHER ELEVEN. The phrasing is a preference — "**Clarion** feels closer" — where the rest are commitments ("I choose: **Cipher**", "I am Threshold"). The name is used 36 times in the turn and opens the reply section as a signature (—**Clarion**), so the reading is well supported, but it is the one of the twelve a sceptic should re-read first.
